title: Joyful Arabic Cauliflower Bowl
description: A savory, light cauliflower bowl with creamy tahini hummus, fresh thyme, and roasted in a clay pot for a fragrant, keto-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C and line an 8-inch clay pot with parchment paper.
Toss cauliflower florets in olive oil, salt, pepper, and chopped thyme, then spread in the clay pot.
Roast cauliflower in the preheated oven for 25 minutes until golden and tender.
While cauliflower roasts, combine tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, and water in a bowl, whisking until smooth and creamy.
After roasting, transfer cauliflower to a serving bowl and top with the creamy hummus.
Drizzle a little extra olive oil over the bowl and garnish with fresh thyme leaves.
Serve immediately for a warm, aromatic dish.
Enjoy with optional side of fresh cucumber slices if desired.
